Description: WhatsApp Business Cloud API integration for Umbraco — backoffice inbox with the 24-hour customer-service window, approved-template and free-form sending, and an inbound webhook receiver. Umbraco 13 (net8.0) and 17 (net10.0); the Lit 3 dashboard requires Umbraco 17.

AuthorDetails.Name: SplatDev
AuthorDetails.Description: SplatDev Ltda — building Umbraco plugins and tools for agencies and developers.

Screenshots.Caption: Inbox — conversations with unread counts, the transcript, and how long the 24-hour reply window has left.
Once the window closes the reply box is disabled rather than letting you send something WhatsApp will reject.
Send an approved template with its variables filled in, previewed before it goes out.
Every template on your WhatsApp Business Account, with approval status and variable count.
